text:
Marta: Belmont Health (acct BLMT-1009) - INV-2026-0421 for $54,320 is 45 days past due. They called this morning asking for a split-pay. Customer reps said cash-constrained due to delayed funding.
Priya: Do we have their payment history? aging buckets?
Marta: Quick aging: 30d $0, 60d $0, 90d+ $54,320. No partials posted.
collections-bot: Reminder email sent to ar@belmonthealth.com at 2026-03-23T09:12:08Z.
Marta: They proposed 40% now, 30% in 30 days, 30% in 60 days. Also asked to waive late fees (currently $1,250).
Avery: Is account flagged as strategic? any open SOWs or active deployments?
Sam_Sales: Yes strategic — doing a live pilot for Redwood Dedicated. We have an in-flight SOW for infra work (~$18k) that we were planning to bill next week. Customer says they will pause if access is cut.
Erika: If we do a payment plan and fee waiver we need a signed amendment: state new schedule + default terms. I won't approve fee waiver >25% without exec signoff.
Priya: Proposed schedule (from Marta):
```
- Due now (upon signing): $21,728 (40%)
- Due +30 days: $16,296 (30%)
- Due +60 days: $16,296 (30%)
- Late fee reduced to $500 flat (from $1,250)
```
Marta: I'll prepare amendment and payment link once we get approval. They can pay via ACH or card at https://pay.redwood.ai/inv/INV-2026-0421
Avery: I'll approve the 40/30/30 schedule and $500 flat fee on condition that: 1) signed amendment uploaded to contract repo, 2) a card on file or ACH mandate is obtained within 48 hours, and 3) Sales confirms no work beyond current pilot until first payment clears. :thumbsup:
Erika: Addendum language to include catch-up clause and interest reinstatement on default. Also require customer billing contact and CFO sign-off for concessions >$50k (we're at $54.3k so escalate if further concessions requested).
Sam_Sales: I'll have the AE get CFO on a quick call today. They agreed to start payment today if we send the ACH link.
Marta: Sent provisional amendment draft to Erika and Avery for review. I'll also open a collections cadence (weekly check-in) and flag in billing system.
collections-bot: Collections task created: follow-up cadence weekly, next reminder 2026-03-30.
Priya: Accounting note for ledger: hold revenue recognition on disputed portion until first installment posts.
Marta: Action items: 1) Sales to secure card/ACH (Sam) 2) Legal to finalize amendment (Erika) 3) Finance to send link and track payments (Marta) 4) No new billable work until first payment (Avery).
Sam_Sales: AE pinged customer; they said they can push initial 40% today by card. Sending me a screenshot once done.
Marta: Got screenshot, pending card authorization. Will confirm when posted.
Avery: Good. If payment posts, we proceed with amendment and resume pilot monitoring.
Erika: I approved the addendum language. I'll drop the file in contracts/BLMT-1009/amendments.
Marta: Update: first payment authorized $21,728, pending settlement. Collections will verify posting tomorrow and update thread.
collections-bot: Payment settled: $21,728 recorded on 2026-03-24. Next reminder scheduled 2026-04-23.
Priya: Noted — update AR and revenue team. I'll adjust aging and recognition flags.
Marta: Closing loop — payment plan approved per above, paperwork filed, pilot remains in soft-hold until settlement verified. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
